decisions.story_title: Vinci RAT delivered via Microsoft Store app through PowerShell backdoor campaign
decisions.reason: Previously undocumented PowerShell backdoor distributed through a Microsoft Store application with search redirection, obfuscated Electron loader and remote payloads; distinct from the September AgtaBackup fake-Store-page campaign.
